title: Sage Haven | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sage Haven is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Escape to the serene Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach and discover Sage Haven, a modernized retreat perfect for your 30A getaway. Tucked away in tranquility, this home boasts a private pool and ample covered patio space underneath, ideal for outdoor leisure and entertainment. Conveniently located just a short walk from the beach, Sage Haven offers the ultimate blend of relaxation and convenience.Inside, find solace on the 1st floor, featuring a practical laundry area and mudroom to store your beach essentials. Ascend to the 2nd floor to unveil the main living area and kitchen, adorned with vaulted ceilings and soothing green tones for a cozy atmosphere. With ample space for gatherings, the main floor accommodates dining for 10 guests and provides additional seating at the peninsula. Step out onto the large balcony to enjoy pool views and refreshing breezes, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploration.Retreat to the 2nd and 3rd floors, where four bedrooms await, each boasting its own private bathroom for added comfort. Designed with practicality and relaxation in mind, Sage Haven promises a tranquil escape for your next 30A vacation.Designed with top-of-the-line finishes in a style that will make you feel truly welcomed, we know you'll enjoy Sage Haven for your next 30A vacation.Sleeping Arrangements:2nd Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, twin-over-twin bunk, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.3rd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, twin-over-twin bunk, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: 2 queen beds, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Beach Access:Head west on Savelle Drive, turning left onto Gulf Breeze Dr. Take this road until it ends (just a little east) at your beach boardwalk.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 3 minutes walkingGrayton Beach:This beach home is located in the quiet neighborhood of Gulf Trace near the heart of Grayton Beach - known for its unique artistic vice. You'll feel like a local walking through this area and quickly become immersed in the local art scene. Grayton welcomes everyone. You'll love the area for its selection of great shops and restaurants. And the location puts you close to all the famous 30A communities. Hop on a bike or in the car to explore the South Walton area to its fullest!Your stay at Sage Haven comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 4 cars.* Golf carts are not allowed in the Gulf Trace community* Sorry, no pets allowed.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
